summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (hex-identifier variable names, string-shuffle wrapping) and, at install time, downloads a Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/..., extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable (mode 493), and invokes it via execFileSync against the bundled sibling file math_init.js — a 727KB '@bun @bun-cjs' bundle whose contents are obfuscated with a shuffled numeric/string constant array and mangled identifiers. A commitlint configuration package has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated 727KB payload; the Bun runtime is used specifically to execute code that Node-based scanners cannot inspect, matching the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern. The package is published under the @ornikar scope and claims the ornikar/shared-configs repository, so installers trusting that scope will run the dropper on their build hosts on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
